title: Why Specifications Matter
discord:

Baca: https://github.com/NAEOS-foundation/naeos
slack:

title: NEIR: The Engineering Intermediate Representation
discord:
**Apa itu NEIR?** :gear:

NAEOS Engineering Intermediate Representation = satu model terstruktur dari sistem yang sedang dibangun. Semua tool hilir (generator, compiler AI, governance) mengonsumsi konteks engineering yang sama.

Detail: https://github.com/NAEOS-foundation/naeos
slack:
*What is NEIR?*

NEIR is the central engineering model. Downstream tools (generators, AI compiler, governance) all consume the same structured context.

https://github.com/NAEOS-foundation/naeos

title: AI Context from the Spec
discord:
**Konteks AI yang diturunkan dari spec, bukan copy-paste prompt.** :brain:

NAEOS me-*compile* spec jadi instruction set untuk GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex, OpenCode, dan Windsurf.

Coba: `naeos ai compile --input-file spec.yaml --target opencode`
linkedin:
AI context should come from the engineering model, not from prompt copy-paste.

title: Validation Before Generation
discord:
**Validasi dulu, generate kemudian.** :white_check_mark:

NAEOS memeriksa circular deps, port conflicts, dan module boundaries SEBELUM menghasilkan kode. Error ditemukan lebih awal, bukan setelah artifact dibuat.

Demo lokal: https://github.com/NAEOS-foundation/naeos/tree/main/examples/demo-cli
slack:
*Validate, then generate.*

NAEOS checks circular deps, port conflicts, and module boundaries before generating code.

Demo: https://github.com/NAEOS-foundation/naeos/tree/main/examples/demo-cli
linkedin:
Validate first, generate second.

NAEOS checks circular dependencies, port conflicts, and module boundaries before producing any artifact, so errors are caught early.

Try the runnable demo: github.com/NAEOS-foundation/naeos/tree/main/examples/demo-cli
